    Collapsing a 2-complex along an acyclic matching #

    Combinatorial tool for Lemma 4.2 (lem:mesh-walk-free). A 2-complex is given by edges Ed with endpoints and triangles t with relation f_t g_t = h_t; its fundamental groupoid Π is the free groupoid on the edges modulo these relations. Given an injective choice of one edge per triangle (a matching) with a potential strictly decreasing from a triangle to the triangles matching its other edges, each matched edge is expressed through the remaining ones — the source's "eliminate these edges and triangles from one end of the chain" — and Π is isomorphic to the free groupoid on the unmatched edges.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
